Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/hooks/use-video-engine.ts:
     1	"use client"
     2	
     3	import { createDecartClient, models } from "@decartai/sdk"
     4	import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"
     5	
     6	function describeMediaError(err: unknown): string {
     7	  if (err instanceof DOMException) {
     8	    if (err.name === "NotAllowedError" || err.name === "PermissionDeniedError") {
     9	      return "Camera/microphone permission denied. Please allow access in your browser settings."
    10	    }
    11	    if (err.name === "NotFoundError") {
    12	      return "No camera or microphone found. Please connect a device and try again."
    13	    }
    14	    if (err.name === "OverconstrainedError") {
    15	      return "Your camera doesn't support the required resolution. Try a different camera."
    16	    }
    17	    return `${err.name}: ${err.message}`
    18	  }
    19	  return String(err)
    20	}
    21	
    22	export type VideoConnectionState =
    23	  | "idle"
    24	  | "connecting"
    25	  | "connected"
    26	  | "generating"
    27	  | "reconnecting"
    28	  | "disconnected"
    29	
    30	type RealtimeClient = Awaited<
    31	  ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof createDecartClient>["realtime"]["connect"]>
    32	>
    33	
    34	export function useVideoEngine() {
    35	  const [state, setState] = useState<VideoConnectionState>("idle")
    36	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
    37	
    38	  const localStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
    39	  const clientRef = useRef<RealtimeClient | null>(null)
    40	  const localVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null)
    41	  const remoteVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null)
    42	
    43	  const start = useCallback(
    44	    async (opts: { prompt?: string; image?: Blob | string | null }) => {
    45	      setError(null)
    46	      setState("connecting")
    47	      try {
    48	        // 1. Mint a short-lived client token from our server.
    49	        const tokenRes = await fetch("/api/realtime-token", { method: "POST" })
    50	        if (!tokenRes.ok) throw new Error("Could not get a realtime token.")
    51	        const { apiKey } = await tokenRes.json()
    52	        if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Realtime token missing from response.")
    53	
    54	        // 2. Get the camera + mic stream at the model's preferred resolution.
    55	        const model = models.realtime("lucy-2.1")
    56	        let stream: MediaStream
    57	        try {
    58	          stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    59	            audio: true,
    60	            video: {
    61	              frameRate: model.fps,
    62	              width: model.width,
    63	              height: model.height,
    64	              facingMode: "user",
    65	            },
    66	          })
    67	        } catch (mediaErr) {
    68	          throw new Error(describeMediaError(mediaErr))
    69	        }
    70	        localStreamRef.current = stream
    71	        if (localVideoRef.current) {
    72	          localVideoRef.current.srcObject = stream
    73	        }
    74	
    75	        // 3. Connect to Decart's realtime engine over WebRTC.
    76	        const client = createDecartClient({ apiKey })
    77	        const realtimeClient = await client.realtime.connect(stream, {
    78	          model,
    79	          mirror: "auto",
    80	          onRemoteStream: (transformedStream: MediaStream) => {
    81	            if (remoteVideoRef.current) {
    82	              remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = transformedStream
    83	            }
    84	          },
    85	          initialState: {
    86	            prompt: opts.prompt
    87	              ? { text: opts.prompt, enhance: true }
    88	              : undefined,
    89	            image: opts.image ?? undefined,
    90	          },
    91	        })
    92	
    93	        clientRef.current = realtimeClient
    94	
    95	        realtimeClient.on("connectionChange", (s: VideoConnectionState) => {
    96	          setState(s)
    97	        })
    98	        realtimeClient.on("error", (e: { code?: string; message: string }) => {
    99	          console.error("[v0] Decart error:", e.code, e.message)
   100	          setError(e.message)
   101	        })
   102	
   103	        setState(realtimeClient.isConnected() ? "connected" : "connecting")
   104	      } catch (e) {
   105	        const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to start video."
   106	        console.error("[v0] start video failed:", message)
   107	        setError(message)
   108	        setState("idle")
   109	        localStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop())
   110	        localStreamRef.current = null
   111	      }
   112	    },
   113	    [],
   114	  )
   115	
   116	  // Atomically replace the transformation state (prompt and/or reference image).
   117	  const update = useCallback(
   118	    async (next: { prompt?: string; image?: Blob | string | null }) => {
   119	      const client = clientRef.current
   120	      if (!client) return
   121	      try {
   122	        await client.set({
   123	          prompt: next.prompt,
   124	          image: next.image ?? undefined,
   125	          enhance: true,
   126	        })
   127	      } catch (e) {
   128	        console.error("[v0] update transform failed:", e)
   129	      }
   130	    },
   131	    [],
   132	  )
   133	
   134	  const stop = useCallback(() => {
   135	    clientRef.current?.disconnect()
   136	    clientRef.current = null
   137	    localStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop())
   138	    localStreamRef.current = null
   139	    if (localVideoRef.current) localVideoRef.current.srcObject = null
   140	    if (remoteVideoRef.current) remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = null
   141	    setState("idle")
   142	  }, [])
   143	
   144	  return {
   145	    state,
   146	    error,
   147	    isActive: state !== "idle" && state !== "disconnected",
   148	    localVideoRef,
   149	    remoteVideoRef,
   150	    start,
   151	    update,
   152	    stop,
   153	  }
   154	}
   155
